label: Melanoma in situ with hairs (ISIC_0000022)
description: Dermoscopic photograph of melanoma in situ occluded by dark hairs (ISIC Archive, CC0).
expectedResult: DullRazor removes dark hairs before lesion segmentation and automated A/B/C morphometry.

label: Asymmetric multi-color melanoma (ISIC_0000002)
description: Dermoscopic photograph of an asymmetric, multi-color melanoma (ISIC Archive, CC0).
expectedResult: Segments the asymmetric lesion and reports automated A/B/C morphometry and multi-class CIE L*a*b* color coverage.

label: Benign melanocytic nevus (ISIC_0000000)
description: Dermoscopic photograph of a symmetric benign melanocytic nevus (ISIC Archive, CC0).
expectedResult: Segments the regular nevus border and reports low automated asymmetry and A/B/C morphometry.
